results.name: Boxing Right Uppercut
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your feet shoulder-width apart, left foot forward, and hands up in a guard position near your chin.
Bend your knees slightly and rotate your hips and shoulders, bringing your right fist upward in a rising arc to throw an uppercut.
Quickly retract your right arm back to the guard position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your non-punching hand up to protect your face and maintain a balanced stance.
Engage your core to generate power and maintain stability.
Focus on driving the punch from your legs and hips to add power to the uppercut.
results.description: Boxing Right Uppercut is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Upper Back.

results.name: Brisk Walking (360 Degree View)
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides.
Begin walking at a brisk pace, ensuring that you take quick, short steps.
Swing your arms naturally with each step, allowing them to move opposite to your legs for balance.
Maintain this brisk pace for the desired duration or distance.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain good posture and stability.
Focus on a heel-to-toe motion with each step to ensure proper walking mechanics.
Breathe steadily and rhythmically to support your pace and endurance.
results.description: Brisk Walking (360 Degree View) is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Burpee To Pull-Up
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank, then jump them back in.
Jump up to grab the bar and pull your chin over it.
Lower yourself, drop down and go straight into the next burpee.
tips: Land softly from the jump before the pull-up.
Use a band on the bar if the pull-up is too hard.
results.description: Burpee To Pull-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Quadriceps, Biceps.

results.name: Burpees
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump your feet back into a plank, then jump them back in toward your hands.
Explode up into a jump, reaching your arms overhead, and land softly into the next rep.
tips: Keep your core tight in the plank so your hips don't sag.
Step back instead of jumping to make it easier.
results.description: Burpees is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Chest, Shoulders.

results.name: Butt Kick With Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you, palms facing down.
Bend your right knee to bring your heel towards your buttocks while simultaneously pulling your elbows back to perform a rowing motion.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left leg, bringing your left heel towards your buttocks while pulling your elbows back.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Keep your upper body upright to maintain proper form and avoid leaning forward.
Perform the rowing motion with controlled movements, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you pull your elbows back.
Ensure each butt kick is high enough to effectively engage the hamstrings.
results.description: Butt Kick With Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Calves, Shoulders.

results.name: Butt Kick (Slow)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides.
Begin by jogging in place, lifting your heels towards your buttocks with each step.

Alternate lifting your right and left heels in a quick, continuous motion, keeping your knees pointing down. Swing your arms naturally with each step, allowing them to move opposite to your legs for balance.
Maintain a steady pace for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper body upright and avoid leaning forward to maintain proper form.
Engage your core to support balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Focus on a quick, light motion with each heel lift to effectively engage your hamstrings.
results.description: Butt Kick (Slow) is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Glutes.

results.name: Cable Twisting Overhead Press
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable machine with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, knees bent at almost 90 degrees and hips pushed back.
Grasp the handle, attached at hip height, with the hand closest to the machine, keeping it close to your shoulder. Place your other hand on your hip.
Twist your torso away from the machine while pushing the handle sideways and straight across your torso, straightening your legs to a standing position as you press the handle.
Slowly return to the starting semi-squat position with control, bringing the handle back to your shoulder. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Use a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you twist and press the handle across your torso, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Twisting Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Triceps, Legs.

results.name: Cardio Lunge
instructions: Begin in a lunge position with your right leg forward and left leg back, ensuring your right knee is aligned over your ankle and your left knee is just above the floor. Bend both arms at your sides.
Explosively push off your left foot, bringing it forward in a small step while pushing your right leg slightly backwards.
Immediately return your left foot back to the starting lunge position.
Continue the explosive movement, maintaining a steady, rhythmic pace. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration, then switch legs.
tips: Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your toes to avoid putting unnecessary strain on your knee.
Perform the movement with a controlled pace to maximize cardiovascular benefits and prevent injury.
Use your arms to help balance and stabilize your movements.
Focus on the explosive movement of the back leg to engage your glutes and hamstrings.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, inhaling as you bring your leg forward and exhaling as you return to the lunge position.
results.description: Cardio Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.
